description: Take a page offline without deleting it: its URL shows an "offline" notice to viewers, and the content, id, URL and view count are kept. Pass restore: true to put it back online at the same URL. Prefer this over delete_page when the human wants a page hidden or paused. Calling it twice is harmless. Returns { ok, id, live }; fails with page_not_found if the id is not in this space.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

restore.description: Default false (take offline). true = put the page back online.

name: unpublish_page
title: Take a page offline or back online
